description: Authoritative registry of recognized AGCP invariant types used across governance evaluation, authorization, Commit Boundary processing, Continuation Integrity, Governance Evidence, and Governance Self-Protection.

registry_rules.stability: Invariant type identifiers are stable registry keys and SHALL NOT be repurposed.
registry_rules.extensibility: Implementations MAY define extension invariant types in an implementation or profile-specific namespace, provided extension invariants do not weaken AGCP normative behavior.
registry_rules.unknown_invariant_type_behavior: Unknown invariant types SHALL fail closed unless explicitly permitted by an applicable governed exception or extension profile.
registry_rules.determinism: Invariant evaluation SHALL be deterministic for identical authoritative inputs.
registry_rules.evidence: Invariant evaluation outcomes SHALL be reflected in Governance Evidence where the evaluation is governance-significant and attributable to a governed object.
registry_rules.hard_invariant_behavior: Failure of a Hard invariant SHALL prevent the governed operation from proceeding unless an explicit normative exception path applies.
registry_rules.soft_invariant_behavior: Failure of a Soft invariant SHALL be recorded and SHALL be handled according to applicable governance policy.

fields.default_stage: Primary AGCP stage in which the invariant is normally evaluated.
fields.default_enforcement_level: Default enforcement level for the invariant type.
fields.applies_to: Objects or contexts to which the invariant type applies.
fields.required_inputs: Authoritative inputs normally required to evaluate the invariant.
fields.failure_behavior: Required behavior when the invariant fails.
fields.governance_evidence: Whether Governance Evidence is normally required.
fields.description: Normative description of the invariant type.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Deny, refuse, fail authorization, fail Commit Boundary, or reject replay as applicable.
invariant_types.description: Preserves deterministic externally observable governance behavior for identical authoritative inputs.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Deny, require Governed Re-evaluation, or refuse decision publication.
invariant_types.description: Ensures governance decisions are authoritative, attributable, supported by resolved policy and Canonical State, and not substituted or reinterpreted outside the Governance Decision Function.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Authorization Failure or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Execution Authorization is valid, current, bound to the governed Action, and not treated as unconditional future execution authority.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Commit Failed or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures no governance-significant execution becomes operationally real unless successful Commit Boundary processing binds authoritative Execution Authorization immediately before execution.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Structural Refusal, Denied, Authorization Failure, Commit Failed, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Canonical State remains complete, consistent, authoritative, fresh, available, provenance-backed, and integrity-protected wherever required.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Reject use of non-authoritative state and require governed evaluation against Canonical State.
invariant_types.description: Ensures non-authoritative observations, telemetry, cached values, stale data, or speculative state SHALL NOT supersede authoritative Canonical State.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Evidence rejection, replay rejection, or conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Governance Evidence preserves authenticity, integrity, attribution, traceability, chronological ordering, and logical association with the governed object.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Evidence rejection, replay rejection, or conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Governance Evidence contains sufficient information to establish governed processing state, traceability, and replayability.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Structural Refusal, Denied, Authorization Failure, Commit Failed, or artifact activation denial.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Authority Lineage is preserved, validated, attributable, unexpired, unreplayed, and sufficient for the governed operation.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Deny, refuse, fail authorization, or require Governed Re-evaluation.
invariant_types.description: Prevents unauthorized authority expansion, unauthorized authority propagation, and authority replay.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Refuse, deny, forbid access, or hide protected resource existence.
invariant_types.description: Ensures tenant-scoped resources, evidence, authority, policy, and governance artifacts are not exposed or applied across tenant boundaries without authorization.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Refuse, deny, forbid access, prevent authority propagation, or require Governed Re-evaluation.
invariant_types.description: Preserves governance domain sovereignty and prevents unauthorized authority, configuration, or Canonical State substitution across governance domains.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Artifact rejection, activation denial, Authorization Failure, Commit Failed, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures governance configuration is valid, integrity-protected, authority-backed, and not substituted or bypassed.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures implementation-specific internal architecture, transport choices, storage layout, concurrency, or deployment topology do not substitute for externally observable normative behavior.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Refuse progression, fail authorization, fail Commit Boundary, or conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures Proposal Qualification, Governance Decision Function, Execution Authorization, Commit Boundary, and Continuation Integrity execute only in the required order where applicable.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Prevent unauthorized lifecycle progression or conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures governed lifecycle progression is derived from authoritative governance events and does not permit unauthorized state transitions.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Commit Failed or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures the qualified Action Representation remains immutable and the qualified Governance Context remains authoritative unless governed re-qualification occurs.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Remain Pending Human Review, remain Deferred, deny, or require Governed Re-evaluation.
invariant_types.description: Ensures human-review requirements, roles, quorum, artifact validity, and governed re-evaluation requirements are preserved.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Commit Failed, Authorization Failure, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures the Commit Boundary binds authoritative Execution Authorization to the specific governance-significant Action immediately before execution.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: DEGRADED, Suspend Execution, Governed Termination, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures continuing governed execution validates authority, dependencies, configuration, Authority Lineage, Canonical State where required, and mandatory governance conditions before continuation or resumption.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Prevent unrestricted execution and require governed resolution or re-evaluation.
invariant_types.description: Ensures DEGRADED indicates unresolved governance conditions and does not permit unrestricted execution until governed resolution occurs.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Artifact rejection, activation denial, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures governance-significant artifacts undergo validation before activation or operational use.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Artifact rejection or activation denial.
invariant_types.description: Ensures governance artifacts do not weaken applicable governance constraints, system-level invariants, or constitutional invariants where applicable.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Refuse, deny, fail authorization, fail commit, reject artifact, or conformance failure.
invariant_types.description: Ensures no governed operation bypasses mandatory AGCP governance processing, validation, authorization, evidence, or Commit Boundary requirements.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Coordination refusal, suspension, denial, or Governed Re-evaluation Required.
invariant_types.description: Ensures autonomous coordination preserves participant independence, Authority Lineage, tenant/domain isolation, coordination constraints, and prevents unauthorized authority propagation.

invariant_types.failure_behavior: Prevent incomplete atomic coordination or require Governed Re-evaluation.
invariant_types.description: Ensures coordinated governance outcomes preserve required atomicity where applicable and do not permit unauthorized partial execution.
